snippet.title: Giraffe and Annika - Announcement Trailer | PS4
snippet.description:
Learn more @ https://nisamerica.com/giraffe-and-annika/

A magical, mystery-filled adventure awaits in Giraffe and Annika! After waking from a strange dream, Annika finds herself stranded on the island of Spica with no memories. With the help of a boy named Giraffe and the witch Lily, she must find three special star fragments on the island in order to uncover her memories.

Coming August 25, 2020 to PS4.
